_comment: ZoeyMemory config for this repo. This is the ONLY file the hooks read - without it every hook exits silently. Plain JSON, no comments: keys starting with `_` are documentation and are stripped by /zoey-memory:init.
name: <project name>

journal._: prompts: the hook logs every user prompt here (COMMITTED). sessions: /zoey-memory:handoff writes 'what is in progress, why we stopped, who decides what'. enabled=false turns automatic logging off.

context._: Loaded into context at session start: the last N prompts + latest session note + open OpenSpec changes + git log.

git._: autoPull: at session start, `pull --ff-only` when behind origin AND the tree is clean AND not diverged. allowCommit/allowPush: may Claude commit/push on its own. workingBranch: the default branch.

outsideGit._: Things that do NOT travel with git and the other machine will be missing - /zoey-memory:start checks these, /zoey-memory:handoff reminds about them.
items: env/secret files (present? pointing at dev or prod DB?)

forbidden._: Things Claude must NEVER do on its own in this repo. Be specific.
items: run data-deleting commands against the real DB
